newsitem.title: USA: UtiliCorp granted $1.7 mln rate increase.
newsitem.headline: UtiliCorp granted $1.7 mln rate increase.

text.p: UtiliCorp United Inc said Thursday the Michigan Public Service Commission approved a $1.7 million, or 1.5 percent, rate increase in the company's annual natural gas revenue.
The company, which had requested a $9.1 million increase, said it is considering a request for reconsideration on some of the issues in the rate order.
UtiliCorp said its new rates will be effective with the April billing cycles for about 141,000 natural gas distribution customers in Michigan served by the company's Michigan Gas Utilities division.

A typical residential customer will see an average monthly increase of $2.18 beginning with the April natural gas bill. The rate order also reduces rates for transportation customers and reduces the monthly fixed costs for smaller transportation customers.

UtiliCorp said the commission granted the rate hike because it determined that the company's currently authorized rates would result in a revenue deficiency in 1997. The previous Michigan Gas Utilities rate increase took effect in 1992.
